# Kaiyi Lu — Browser-Native Engineering Tools & Computational Geometry Specs

> Independent engineering index (https://kaiyilu.github.io/) of zero-dependency JavaScript / TypeScript geometry solvers and zero-upload browser web tools across 2D DXF/SVG sheet-metal laser quoting, planar stained-glass & woodworking fretwork CAD, IES photometric grids, IRC framing & structural masonry calculators, deterministic bitmask puzzle engines, and client-side ecommerce image pipelines.

## Open-Source Specifications & Zero-Dependency ES Modules

- [dxf-laser-quote-math](https://kaiyilu.github.io/dxf-laser-quote-math/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/kaiyilu/dxf-laser-quote-math)): Autodesk DXF group-code `42` `LWPOLYLINE` bulge arc length, `1/64` Arbitrary Axis (`210/220/230` OCS -> WCS) transforms, `2`-core contour pierce counting, and cent-exact sheet-metal laser cutting quote reconciliation.
- [grid-and-fretwork-math](https://kaiyilu.github.io/grid-and-fretwork-math/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/kaiyilu/grid-and-fretwork-math)): 31-bit bitmask Nonogram line deduction, mid-game partial-state continuation & cell-by-cell lookahead contradiction proofs, 4-connected Marching Squares closed-loop contours (`99.2%` IoU), half-pixel `(2W+1)×(2H+1)` Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher EDT wire-gauge (`#65–#44`) pinhole sealing, `40 px/in` (`304.80 mm`) cut-to-cut calibration, 2D BFS stencil island auto-bridging, and zero-dependency `/ToUnicode` + 1:1 tiled vector PDF math.
- [stained-glass-svg-math](https://kaiyilu.github.io/stained-glass-svg-math/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/kaiyilu/stained-glass-svg-math)): Planar half-edge polygon partitioning, shared interior seam deduplication, and inward mitered copper-foil / lead-came kerf offsets.
- [building-layout-math](https://kaiyilu.github.io/building-layout-math/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/kaiyilu/building-layout-math)): IES lumen-method & 2D rotated physical fixture RCP collision math (overhead garage-door track bay caps + ceiling fan strobe radial push with `baseGrid` & `fanShifted` schedules), `1/4"=1'-0"` (`1:48`) & `ISO 1:50` CAD scale viewports, IRC R312.1.3 `< 4"` baluster centering, carpenter `1/16"` tape rounding, and retaining wall block/gravel math.
- [ecommerce-image-specs](https://kaiyilu.github.io/ecommerce-image-specs/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/kaiyilu/ecommerce-image-specs)): Marketplace image specification matrices, Canvas2D pure-white perimeter checks, and Amazon 85% product frame-fill math.
- [canvas-story-deck-kit](https://kaiyilu.github.io/canvas-story-deck-kit/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/kaiyilu/canvas-story-deck-kit)): Web Crypto Fisher-Yates deck shuffling, spread coordinate geometry, and `1080×1920` Canvas2D card rendering.

## Production Browser-Native Web Tools

- [LaserQuote Studio — Laser Cutting Cost Calculator (DXF & SVG)](https://lasercuttingcostcalculator.com/): Client-side 2D `.dxf` & `.svg` CAD geometry parser measuring true bulge-arc cut length, pierce count, open-loop kerf warnings, cycle-time estimates, and [Multi-Part White-Label PDF/CSV Quotes](https://lasercuttingcostcalculator.com/pricing/).
- [Scroll Saw Pattern Generator](https://scrollsawpatterngenerator.com/): `99.2%` IoU 4-connected Marching Squares `1:1` US Letter & A4 tiled vector PDFs, Floating-Island Export Guard + Intarsia multi-piece override, `304.80 mm` zero-padding flat-bottom welded CJK/Latin [Name Plaques](https://scrollsawpatterngenerator.com/scroll-saw-name-pattern-maker/) with open-top descender relief coves & half-pixel EDT wire-gauge (`#65–#44`) pinhole sealing, [Photo Stencils](https://scrollsawpatterngenerator.com/stencil-maker-from-photo/), [Wood Burning](https://scrollsawpatterngenerator.com/wood-burning-pattern-generator/), and [Blade Chart](https://scrollsawpatterngenerator.com/scroll-saw-blade-chart/).
- [Stained Glass Pattern Generator](https://stainedglasspatterngenerator.com/): Planar half-edge shared-seam & kerf-compensated copper-foil / lead-came templates for [Photo-to-Pattern](https://stainedglasspatterngenerator.com/photo-to-stained-glass-pattern/), [SVG CAD](https://stainedglasspatterngenerator.com/svg-stained-glass-pattern-generator/), [Suncatchers](https://stainedglasspatterngenerator.com/suncatcher-stained-glass-patterns/), and [Glass Costing](https://stainedglasspatterngenerator.com/stained-glass-cost-calculator/).
- [Lighting Layout Calculator](https://lightinglayoutcalculator.com/): IES lumen-method & 128-point inverse-square task-zone illuminance, 2D rotated linear fixture & overhead garage-door track collision audit, ceiling fan strobe avoidance with base+shifted schedules, and `1/4"=1'-0"` (`1:48`) & `ISO 1:50` bilingual CAD SVG/PDF Reflected Ceiling Plan exports across [Recessed](https://lightinglayoutcalculator.com/recessed-lighting-layout-calculator/), [Garage](https://lightinglayoutcalculator.com/garage-lighting-layout-calculator/), [High Bay](https://lightinglayoutcalculator.com/high-bay-lighting-calculator/), [Shop Lights](https://lightinglayoutcalculator.com/shop-light-calculator/), and [LED](https://lightinglayoutcalculator.com/led-lighting-layout-calculator/) layouts.
- [Baluster Spacing Calculator](https://balusterspacingcalculator.com/): 2024 IRC R312.1.3 `< 4"` sphere & R507.5 framing layouts with zero-drift `1/16"` hook-tape schedules for [Spindles](https://balusterspacingcalculator.com/spindle-spacing-calculator/), [Pickets](https://balusterspacingcalculator.com/picket-spacing-calculator/), [Deck Posts](https://balusterspacingcalculator.com/deck-post-spacing-calculator/), [Deck Footings](https://balusterspacingcalculator.com/deck-footing-calculator/), and [Fence Posts](https://balusterspacingcalculator.com/fence-post-spacing-calculator/).
- [Retaining Wall Block Calculator](https://retainingwallblockcalculator.com/): IRC R404.4 & NCMA base embedment, geogrid tieback, and two-zone aggregate BOM schedules for [Drainage Gravel](https://retainingwallblockcalculator.com/retaining-wall-gravel-calculator/), [Timber Walls](https://retainingwallblockcalculator.com/timber-retaining-wall-calculator/), [Cinder Block Walls](https://retainingwallblockcalculator.com/cinder-block-wall-calculator/), and [CMU Fill](https://retainingwallblockcalculator.com/cmu-block-fill-calculator/).
- [NonogramGrid](https://nonogramgrid.com/): Uniqueness-verified `5x5–20x20` picture logic puzzles featuring a unique-solution switching-component guard at [Photo Generator](https://nonogramgrid.com/nonogram-generator/) (`Clean Silhouette`, `Sharp Contours` & `Portrait Dither`), mid-game partial-board [Step Solver](https://nonogramgrid.com/nonogram-solver/) with bulk clue paste & cell-by-cell lookahead contradiction proofs, 30-puzzle progressive `Mix 5->20` bilingual `/ToUnicode` vector PDF booklets at [Printable PDFs](https://nonogramgrid.com/printable-nonogram-puzzles/) (US Letter & A4 + separate answer keys), and [Daily Nonogram](https://nonogramgrid.com/daily-nonogram/).
- [QuickKit](https://usequickkit.com/): Browser-local [Excel URL Downloader](https://usequickkit.com/how-to-download-files-from-excel-urls), [SKU Image Downloader](https://usequickkit.com/bulk-download-product-images-by-sku), [Shopify Bulk Resizer](https://usequickkit.com/shopify-bulk-image-resizer), [Amazon](https://usequickkit.com/amazon-main-image-checker), and [Etsy](https://usequickkit.com/etsy-listing-photo-checker) image checkers.
- [VibeKit](https://usevibekit.com/): Zero-account interactive Canvas2D decks including [Yes/No Tarot](https://usevibekit.com/yes-or-no-tarot), [Situationship Spread](https://usevibekit.com/situationship-tarot-spread), and [Daily Vibe Card](https://usevibekit.com/daily-vibe-card).
